instruction: Implement environment.expand(pairs, base). base maps valid uppercase environment names to strings; pairs is an ordered list of [name, template] assignments. Process each assignment against base plus earlier assignments; later assignments overwrite values. ${NAME} inserts the current value without recursively expanding inserted text; $$ inserts one literal dollar. A lone dollar, unclosed placeholder, or name outside [A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]* raises ValueError; missing references raise KeyError. Assignment names are valid. A self-reference can use the previous value. Return the full effective dictionary, preserving both inputs. Standard library only.
